exams.name: Administering Windows Server Hybrid Core Infrastructure
exams.blurb: Windows Server hybrid exam on identity, compute, network infrastructure and storage; Microsoft is replacing AZ-800 and AZ-801 with the single AZ-802.

exams.name: Configuring Windows Server Hybrid Advanced Services
exams.blurb: Second Windows Server hybrid exam covering security, high availability, disaster recovery, migration and monitoring; being replaced by AZ-802.

exams.name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert
exams.blurb: Expert exam on Microsoft 365 tenant administration covering Entra identity, Defender security, Purview compliance and Copilot governance.

exams.name: Microsoft 365 Certified: AI Services Administrator Associate
exams.blurb: Associate certification announced for 2026 covering administration of Microsoft 365 AI services, agent governance and tenant-level AI controls.

exams.name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Collaboration Communications Systems Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on Teams voice and meeting room engineering, covering Direct Routing, Operator Connect, calling plans and device management.

exams.name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on deploying and securing Windows endpoints with Intune and Autopilot, covering compliance policies, apps and device lifecycle.

exams.name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals
exams.blurb: Fundamentals exam on Microsoft 365 cloud services, productivity, security and licensing; Microsoft retired it on 31 March 2026 with no direct successor.

exams.name: Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on configuring and managing Microsoft Teams including governance, meetings, apps, policies and collaboration workloads.

exams.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals
exams.blurb: Fundamentals certification introduced in 2026 covering Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing, deployment, agent management and governance.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: AI Agent Builder Associate
exams.blurb: Associate certification on building production Microsoft Copilot Studio agents and multi-agent solutions with workflow automation and integration.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on managing Azure identities, governance, storage, compute, virtual networking and monitoring of Azure resources.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam introduced in 2026 on building generative AI applications and production agents with Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI services.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate certification introduced in 2026 for developers building and managing AI solutions on Azure using cloud-native application architectures.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on building Azure AI solutions with vision, language, search and OpenAI services; retired by Microsoft in June 2026 in favour of AI-103.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals
exams.blurb: Updated fundamentals exam that replaced AI-900 in 2026, covering generative AI concepts and building basic AI applications and agents on Azure.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900)
exams.blurb: Fundamentals exam on AI workloads, machine learning, computer vision and language services; Microsoft retired AI-900 in June 2026 in favour of AI-901.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Retired in March 2025, this associate exam covered Azure data storage, batch and stream processing with Synapse and Databricks, and pipeline security.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals
exams.blurb: Fundamentals exam covering relational and non-relational data concepts, analytics workloads and core Azure data services and roles.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on running machine learning workloads in Azure Machine Learning; retired in June 2026 and succeeded by the MLOps Engineer credential.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on administering SQL Server and Azure SQL, covering provisioning, security, performance tuning, high availability and automation.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Databricks Data Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Certification introduced in 2026 covering scalable and secure data pipelines on Azure Databricks for real-time analytics and AI-ready data.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam for developers building Azure solutions with App Service, Functions, containers, storage, Cosmos DB, messaging and security.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals
exams.blurb: Entry-level Microsoft exam covering cloud concepts, core Azure services, security, governance, pricing and support; the certification does not expire.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on designing and implementing Azure networking including virtual networks, hybrid connectivity, routing, load balancing and security.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on securing Azure workloads through identity and access, platform protection, security operations and data and application security.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
exams.blurb: Expert exam on designing Azure identity, governance, data storage, business continuity and infrastructure solutions; requires AZ-104 as a prerequisite.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty
exams.blurb: Specialty exam on planning, deploying and managing Azure Virtual Desktop host pools, images, FSLogix profiles, access control and monitoring.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Certification introduced in 2026 covering end-to-end security controls for cloud and AI workloads across Azure and Microsoft security services.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert
exams.blurb: Expert exam on designing zero trust security strategy, governance and risk architecture across Microsoft cloud and hybrid estates.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert
exams.blurb: Expert exam on DevOps practice with Azure DevOps and GitHub, covering source control, pipelines, infrastructure as code, security and monitoring.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Business Central Developer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate developer exam on building Business Central extensions with AL, covering data models, events, testing, integration and app publishing.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Business Central Functional Consultant Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on setting up and configuring Dynamics 365 Business Central including finance, sales, purchasing, inventory and reporting.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Contact Center AI Engineer Associate
exams.blurb: Associate certification on designing and running contact centre as a service solutions with Dynamics 365 Contact Center and autonomous agents.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Experience Analyst Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam covering Dynamics 365 customer experience apps, configuring sales and marketing capabilities and analysing customer data with Copilot.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data Specialty
exams.blurb: Specialty exam on customer data platform work in Dynamics 365 Customer Insights covering ingestion, unification, enrichment and segmentation.

exams.name: Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys Functional Consultant Associate
exams.blurb: Associate exam on marketing automation in Dynamics 365 covering segments, customer journeys, email marketing, events and lead management.
